commitMessage:
Reseller impersonation only with a time-limited admin grant per customer

- Resellers page: 'Izin Impersonate' dialog per reseller to allow chosen
  customers until a time (2 hours, 24 hours, 3 days or custom) with an
  optional reason, and to revoke active grants. Stored on the reseller as
  'impersonateGrants'.
- Users page for resellers: the Impersonate button appears only for
  customers with an active grant; other customers get 'Minta izin
  impersonate', which copies a request message and opens WhatsApp when the
  server support link is a wa.me link.
- Before a reseller impersonates, the app writes 'lastImpersonation' on
  the customer; the server logs that edit under the reseller. The Audit
  page pairs it with the customer's login (within 2 minutes, same IP, one
  trail per login) into '<reseller> impersonate pengguna <customer>'.
- Docs updated.
